title: phase-u: Strict managed sc-lint adoption and frozen dependency carry-in
description:
## Goal
Adopt the supported sc-lint kit at0.8.5 with every rule strict, preserve complete tests/reporting and carry all already-built dependency work into the same phase. Nothing targets develop directly except the single phase integration PR. Current planning baseline is origin/develop caa43cfca893f81724d30719c8de820c9f8567fd.

## Sprint set
| Sprint | Scope | Hard prerequisites | Release gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| U.1 | Frozen dependency/ADR carry-in; one18-row checklist | none | none |
| U.2 | Strict policy encoding and canonical identity fixtures | U.1; open D1/D2 decisions |0.8.4 evidence sufficient |
| U.3 | Accept finished CLI function seams,8 commits | U.1 | none |
| U.4 | Accept finished Beads function seams,6 commits | U.1 | none |
| U.5 | Accept finished composer function seams,11 commits | U.1 | none |
| U.6 | Windows/PyO3 cross rows and evidence | U.2 | supported0.8.4 rows can start; upstream leak remains blocking if unresolved |
| U.7 | Managed0.8.5 kit/pin/adapter/CI migration | U.6 (therefore U.2) | published0.8.5 kit/native/wheel |
| U.8 | #648 deterministic Clap CLI reference, installer and website | U.7 | release1.8.0; consumes managed CI contract |
| U.9 | Combined acceptance, whole-phase ending review and final develop handoff | U.3,U.4,U.5,U.8 | published0.8.5; final mac/CI/reference proofs |

U.1's table is the only frozen PR checklist. Prior QA PASS is preserved; every row is also reviewed in U.9 aggregate scope. All25 function refactors already exist on fix/lint-function-length at ab07145be770ec2e1140840814bde778ab0288eb based on#841; U.3-U.5 accept that work, never recreate/split/rewrite it. Containers remain open until their delivered work/evidence is accepted; no claim those local commits are already phase-merged.

## Open decisions — NOT approved defaults
D1 OPEN: propose [line_counts] max_production_lines=1000, no exclusions;175 files passed, max807. User must decide before U.2 closes.
D2 OPEN: propose exact forbidden test literals randlee/team-lead/arch-comp/arch-ccomp/comp/comps/team-lead@example.invalid/ATM_HOME, no production owner for those; canonical owners for SC_COMPOSE_DATA_DIR and SC_COMPOSE_TEMPLATE_DIR in template_store.rs, and SC_COMPOSE_TEMPLATE_CONTRACTS_SCOPE in commands/template_lint.rs. Policy input and identity/boundary test drivers consume ONE canonical non-Rust JSON fixture. repo_boundaries.rs:206 must load ATM_HOME from it, not concat! or a lint exemption. User must approve before encoding/closure. No policy is presumed approved and no justified exception is currently proposed.

## Follow-on prose only — no reserved sprint numbers
Held toml1, quick-xml0.42, MiniJinja3, clap/serde/thiserror and duplicate-version bumps are separate follow-on work after this strict contract and phase acceptance. They have no sprint here. Already-built updates in U.1 remain frozen; do not re-plan them or the already-fixed inventory/dev-edge/Zlib work. No advisory/Clippy/identity/size exception is authorized.

## Release issue ledger — both REQUIRED for1.8.0
| Issue | Release label | Phase owner / delivered scope | Status / final gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#648](https://github.com/randlee/sc-compose/issues/648) — Clap-generated CLI reference in installer and website |1.8.0 | U.8, actual Clap-tree deterministic generation, versioned offline Markdown + matching navigable static website; auto-regenerate and reject drift | OPEN required release scope; U.9 reviews packaging/installed/offline/site/version proofs |
| [#817](https://github.com/randlee/sc-compose/issues/817) — replace deprecated serde_yaml/unsafe-libyaml |1.8.0 | U.1 carry-in PR#839, already-built QA-approved YAML advisory repair; do not re-plan it | OPEN release accounting; U.9 verifies the frozen repair in aggregate and released dependency graph |
No issue is closed or relabeled remotely by this local planning task. The ledger is the1.8.0 phase commitment, not a claim a release has published.
design:
## Boundary map
- BOUNDARY-ScCompose owns sc-lint process invocation/normalization/report HTML and root developer orchestration; sc-lint owns rules and envelopes. Preserve fixed executable/allowlisted descriptors (ADR0016/0017).
- BOUNDARY-ScComposer stays pure: private completed composition/extraction/schema changes preserve API/diagnostic/span semantics; no CLI/ATM dependencies.
- BOUNDARY-ScComposerBeads retains host-neutral argv/receipts/graph/quoting; no test-support dependency reintroduction (ADR0021/0023).
- Directed edges stay CLI->composer/beads, beads->composer, composer->sc-sha, Python/Go adapters->owned libraries. Inventory corrections#836, Zlib removal#837, dev-edge removal#838, YAML advisory repair#839, generator repair#840 and stale workspace cleanup#841 are finished inputs, not new scope.

## Delivery and authorized writers — two landing stages
integrate/phase-u is the integration destination, initially from origin/develop caa43cfc. Historical stack#825 currently targeted develop and must be migrated; no dependency/sprint PR is to land directly on develop. The user now directs #831 plus the17#825 carry-in rows to LAND EARLY ON integrate/phase-u, by comp once the CI exit3 question is settled. They do NOT wait for U.9 aggregate acceptance. #831 is first beneath the dependency content. Preserve frozen code/QA and record any mechanical old->new head mapping. Lead coordinates user-authorized rebase/relink; comp is the explicitly authorized carry-in landing writer for that step, with one active writer at a time. This plan author executes none of those writes.

Intermediate CI: #836 corrects the newer boundary inventory, so the old pinned0.4.0 Set up lint toolchain step exits3 on the integrated carry-in. That RED state is expected on integrate/phase-u until U.7 replaces the contract with the managed kit. Settle/classify the exit3 question before comp's early carry-in landing; do not disable a rule, suppress a check or claim final CI green. The existing carry-in QA PASS stays recorded, and actual landed/dropped dispositions go on U.1's SAME table. Include#842 docs when composing the25-commit function branch based on#841, so neither is lost.

Later/final develop handoff remains lead-run with user go-ahead: fetch fresh origin/develop, perform the authorized complete phase/stack sync/rebase onto new develop (not an ad-hoc merge only into an integration root beneath live descendants), record heads/bases/stack number and content/containment evidence, freeze trunk writers and rerun final proofs/review if a candidate changes. Existing stack numbers/heads are observations, never guessed after relink. Once U.9 aggregate and whole-phase ending review PASS plus explicit user approval are recorded, the authorized lead lands the SINGLE integrate/phase-u -> develop PR via gh stack merge. Early integration landing is distinct from this final develop gate.

## Sanity and closure
Per explicit lead ruling, dev-sanity is read-only numbered-deliverable verification, no lint execution and not QA. Global strict debt does not block independent completed seam acceptance. Only U.9 owns final aggregate green and the full-phase ending review; only develop integration and phase closure wait for that final gate. Carry-in landing on integrate/phase-u is explicitly permitted EARLY after the exit3 settlement. No phase closes with an unaccounted U.1 PR or incomplete1.8.0 issue ledger. Groups/QA are poured later by the installed orchestrator, not created manually here.

## Release and technical contract
0.8.5 is an explicit release gate, not assumed published. Confirm kit/native/wheel versions, helper policy/default profile/logging/artifacts support, corrected managed Python PATH, ARM64 support and packaged pytests fix from the actual released artifact before U.7/U.9. Retain packaged pytests; do not omit it to pass0.8.4. The sc-lint lead confirmed work lint-085.18/QA lint-085.19; research handoffs are in /Users/randlee/.codex/reports/sc-lint-0.8.4-adoption-plan-20261103/upstream-confirmed-reply*.txt.
Analyzer exit10 keeps ok:true/data.findings; helper exit5 has ok:false/error.details.findings, capped10 plus true findings_count. Preserve raw exit/envelope and true totals. Config errors3/usage2/profile.steps_failed failed_steps[{index,name,exit_code,message,step_log_destination?,step_log_error?}]. Version uses data.version+self_contained. Never let the consumer reporter's legacy Findings exit0 make a strict gate green.

## Waves/ownership
U.2/U.3/U.4/U.5 follow accepted frozen baseline and have disjoint implementation/verification file fences; U.6 consumes U.2 policy; U.7 consumes complete policy/cross declarations; U.8 consumes the managed contract to wire deterministic CLI-reference drift/release checks; U.9 accepts all. Critical path6 (U.1->U.2->U.6->U.7->U.8->U.9), width4, sprint count9. That six-deep path carries actual artifacts: fixed baseline->policy->cross declarations->managed kit->generated-reference check/delivery->aggregate. Existing source work is reused, not serially reimplemented. Physical append order follows the declared sprint branches, even for semantically independent scope; no independent phase roots/forks. Plan metadata names no assignee.

The committed docs/phase-u/beads-plan.jsonl is the frozen pre-import payload for lead review/import, not an alternate runtime plan. Vars/partial renders stay outside the repo. After confirmed import, Beads is authoritative and this snapshot is historical import evidence; no parallel Markdown sprint docs or synchronization process are introduced.
## Additional CLI documentation delivery boundary
U.8/#648 adds CLI-owned deterministic reference tooling based on the actual Clap command tree, with offline installer Markdown and static site/ output as two consumers of ONE generation result. Retain existing embedded conceptual manuals (FR-22), command grammar and pure-library boundaries. No new parser definitions, handwritten option inventory or held Clap-version upgrade is authorized by this scope. Release1.8.0 preparation regenerates both and CI/release rejects missing/stale output. This is a single user-required integration sprint; no extra ceremony or split publishing project.

title: u-2: strict-policy-encoding
description:
## Deliverables
1. Once OPEN D1/D2 are explicitly decided, encode required line_counts/identities/version_sync/cargo_shear policy in sc-lint.toml and prove it with the released0.8.4 product. Do not wait for0.8.5 just to encode policy; do not claim0.8.4 kit convergence. D1 proposed1000 production lines, no exclusions. Version sync includes Cargo.lock and all3 Python manifests.
2. For approved D2, author ONE non-Rust canonical fixture JSON shared by policy input and identity/boundary test drivers; include ATM_HOME only with repo_boundaries.rs replacing concat! with that canonical lookup. Canonical store env names become constants at template_store.rs and commands consume them without changing error text. No obfuscation/site allow/path exemption or new raw operator identities.
3. Enable every boundary/portability/runtime rule strictly and meaningful policy tables, zero function-growth allowances. Do not repeat#836/#837/#838/#841 repairs or revive the .just helper fallback. Retain only the product-required tracked zero-allowance baseline data, not copied scripts.
4. Provide the approved policy fields as the input artifact consumed unchanged by U.6/U.7; the old executable pin is not changed to an invented intermediate version by this encoding sprint.
design: D1/D2 are OPEN user decisions in root description; no defaults silently become acceptance. Supported helper tables can be proven with explicit0.8.4 invocations independently of the unreleased kit. Final managed ownership/0.8.5 pin belongs to U.7, which consumes this policy rather than editing a managed file after rendering. Test token data use serde_json/include_str or a fixture loader, no new production dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Record D1/D2 decisions before closing. Run cargo test --workspace; targeted identity/boundary/CLI diagnostics tests; exact0.8.4 line-count/identity/version checks with explicit config and interpreter. Evidence: comp probe on ee01fa76 had version_sync(all3 Python manifests), prod1000 and compatibility PASS; the intentional ATM_HOME test finding must disappear through shared fixture data, not exemption. Independent full aggregate debt may be reported but never waived; final green belongs U.9. Sanity checks deliverables/evidence read-only.

title: u-8: generated-cli-reference
description:
## Issue/release
Issue#648: https://github.com/randlee/sc-compose/issues/648 — Next release: ship Clap-generated CLI reference in installer and website. REQUIRED release1.8.0 scope, not optional follow-on. Existing feature manuals are conceptual and embedded; Pages currently deploys static site/. This sprint creates deterministic executable tooling and its installed/web delivery, retaining those manuals.
## Deliverables
1. Add deterministic tooling that traverses the ACTUAL Clap command tree derived from cli/schema.rs through CommandFactory, including every public nested subcommand, usage, options/global options, defaults, possible values and available long help/examples. Generate content from definitions only; agents may improve source help/attribution, never author a second reference option list. Hidden/internal tooling is excluded by Clap visibility semantics; current conceptual help/manuals remain available and unchanged in role.
2. Provide developer/release command just generate-cli-reference mode="write" (or check), using one generator output model for BOTH a versioned Markdown manual crates/sc-compose/docs/reference/sc-compose-<release-version>.md and equivalent navigable site/manual/cli-reference.html. Both identify the same release version and cover the same command inventory; stable command-path anchors, a table of contents and accessible website navigation expose every public command. No timestamps, host paths, locale or terminal-width randomness.
3. Ship the versioned Markdown with release assets AND installer-managed payloads, accessible offline at a documented share/sc-compose/manual location. Extend consumer-owned release manifest/template/input bundled_paths so all declared archives and applicable installer channels preserve the manual; validate an extracted/installed package offline, not just a repository file. Retain existing conceptual manuals and examples. Do not edit duplicated vendored sc-publish internals; use supported consumer inputs/generated surfaces and escalate any upstream capability gap rather than forking release tooling.
4. Release preparation automatically regenerates BOTH outputs for the actual release version from the same Clap definitions BEFORE artifact staging, and CI/release validation rejects missing/stale/wrong-version/incomplete outputs. Consume U.7's managed aggregate profile contract to add the deterministic check; regeneration is a required release step, not a manual reminder. Pages continues serving static site/ with explicit navigation to the matching reference; no separate handwritten website option inventory.
5. Attach coverage/equivalence/stale-negative/package-install/offline/navigation proof; keep issue#648 OPEN/pending until its acceptance is met and accounted for in final Phase U review. No release publish/deploy is performed merely by completing this plan.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Actual Clap-tree inventory equals generated Markdown AND HTML inventory: every public command/subcommand, usage, option/default/allowed value and available help/example is represented. Deterministic fixed-input generation twice yields identical bytes; meaningful schema mutation (new option/default/subcommand) proves the stale check fails until regeneration. No sleeps/event-loop/order-based tests and no manually maintained second option list.
2. just generate-cli-reference write && just generate-cli-reference check pass; cargo test --workspace and targeted CLI-reference coverage/equivalence/escaping tests pass. Existing conceptual sc-compose help/manual tests still pass. CI check mode exits nonzero for missing Markdown, missing HTML, stale Clap metadata or wrong release version, without silently regenerating away a failure.
3. Release preparation invokes the generator for the release version and fails before archive/upload if either output is absent/stale. Fixture-based archive/installer validation extracts/installs declared payloads and locates/read-checks the versioned Markdown offline at the documented installed path; supported channel manifests preserve it. No production release publication is needed for these controlled checks.
4. Website page heading/version/anchors correspond to that SAME generated manual, all links resolve within static site/, and site/index.html navigation exposes it. A packaged1.8.0 release fixture and website reference both identify1.8.0. Final U.9 verifies#648 together with#817 in the1.8.0 issue ledger and full-phase diff. Release1.8.0 may not omit this issue's deliverables.
